one-piece-open: One undivided 245.4 mL bin. A flat round face covers the bore and a closed finger cup provides the grip.
one-piece-left-right: The fixed divider runs the length of the bin, creating two long lanes.
one-piece-front-back: One chevron divider separates front from back. Its pitched shape prints without supports.
dry-ends: Four half-feet go at the outer ends of the bottom row, one at each front and rear corner. Move them outward as you add cores.
base-mount: One front and one rear piece sit between neighboring bottom cores. They share a flat base and tie together.
upper-mount: One front and one rear three-way junction seat an upper core between the two below. Tie the pair together.
middle-mount: This is the same tied junction as the upper connector, with a #8 wood screw through the rear eye into the plywood.
top-tier: The tied upper junction and tied rim clips secure a new top cell. Only the rear tab screws to the plywood.
top-clips: A cable tie connects the front keeper to the rear screw tab over the top core. The wood screw sits above the rim.
core: Reused spool tube, not printed. This example uses nominal 83 mm ID × 88 mm OD × 60 mm length.
tie: One 2.5 × 200 mm tie captures each ordinary front/rear connector pair without adhesive.
wood-screw: A #8 × ¾″ pan-head wood screw through the rear tab fastens it to the plywood. The shelf supports the bank.
triangle-pocket: A small removable tray for screws or pins, with a recessed nail grip. Its fixed carrier is tied above the tray.
triangle-pocket-frame: This stays on the core rims when you remove the bin. The front and rear pieces tie together.
left-pocket: A removable bin for longer small parts in the left half-gap. The fixed front and rear uprights carry the upper core.
left-pocket-frame: This stays on the core rims when you remove the bin. The front and rear pieces tie together.
right-pocket: A removable bin for longer small parts in the right half-gap. The fixed front and rear uprights carry the upper core.
right-pocket-frame: This stays on the core rims when you remove the bin. The front and rear pieces tie together.
